tool.name: GmxCheck
tool.description: Wrapper of the GROMACS check module for comparing and validating GROMACS files.

param.name: input_structure_path
param.help: Path to the first GROMACS run input file

param.name: input_structure_2_path
param.help: Path to the second GROMACS run input file

param.name: input_traj_path
param.help: Path to the first GROMACS trajectory file

param.name: input_traj_2_path
param.help: Path to the second GROMACS trajectory file

param.name: input_energy_path
param.help: Path to the first GROMACS energy file

param.name: input_energy_2_path
param.help: Path to the second GROMACS energy file

param.name: structure_check_path
param.help: Path to the structure file to analyze for internal consistency

param.name: input_index_path
param.help: Path to the GROMACS index file

param.name: outname_output_log_path
param.help: Path to the text file storing the gmx check console output

param.name: config_json
param.label: Configuration file
param.help: File containing tool settings. See below for the syntax
